title: Building Measurements, CSV Import, and UCI Reference Building Import

units.Appliances/lights: Wh per observed interval; UCI interval ten minutes

ownership.all_roles: Active authenticated USER/ADMIN must own parent Building; no admin bypass
ownership.lookup: Uniform404 for missing/nonowned building; delete additionally filters measurement building_id
ownership.mutations: Existing CSRF guard; server derives building association from owned route; extra JSON fields forbidden
ownership.private_responses: Existing no-store and credentialed CORS retained

validation.numeric: Strict finite JSON numbers; CSV converts numeric text then validates; no arbitrary physical range bounds
validation.timestamp: ISO date/time without timezone, naive building-local; original UCI space separator accepted; no offsets/Z, epochs or date-only input
validation.precision: Stored at Python datetime microsecond precision
validation.duplicates: Database uniqueness on building/timestamp; in-file duplicate422, existing/race conflict409; nothing partially inserted
validation.unknown_fields: Forbidden except explicitly ignored CSV rv1/rv2
validation.general_intervals: Arbitrary valid timestamps accepted; no ten-minute storage restriction

pagination.statistics: SQL count/min/max over all measurements in the owned building, not only current page
pagination.indexes: Existing building/timestamp indexes and uniqueness retained

csv.errors: Structured safe first error with CSV record number and field where available; no raw values or stack traces
csv.upload_storage: UploadFile memory/OS spool, bounded read, close in finally; no permanent repository uploads
csv.transaction: Validate complete file before writes; precheck existing timestamps in batches; insert bulk batches500, one commit; uniqueness closes races, rollback on integrity failure/session errors
csv.performance: No per-row commits, ML model loading, preprocessing or jobs

reference_importer.owner: Explicit selected existing active ADMIN; no promotion, startup seeding or per-user copying
reference_importer.name: UCI Reference Building
reference_importer.description: Explicit UCI source/model development-validation provenance and reference research/not live data; no invented city/type/area
reference_importer.identity: Owner + reserved name + exact provenance description; ambiguous/name collisions reject; exact empty reference may be populated
reference_importer.repeated_import: Reject if any history already exists, leaving rows/building unchanged
reference_importer.schema_change: None; no is_reference field needed for explicit serial local utility
reference_importer.concurrency_limit: Run serially; name uniqueness is not enforced; metadata rename can remove utility identity

frontend.manual_entry: All raw fields required without fabricated defaults; grouped Energy/Indoor/Outdoor with documented units
frontend.csv_ui: File picker, header-only download, format policy, committed result/count/range and structured row errors
frontend.history: Real total/date range, concise database-value table, all-fields disclosure, pagination, confirmation/cancel delete, loading/error/retry/empty states
frontend.readiness: Counts only; no ML readiness percentage or count-based ready claim; continuity/lag validation deferred to Phase25

known_limitations: Naive local time cannot resolve timezone/DST ambiguity or cross-building absolute time
Offset pagination is not a snapshot under concurrent writes
Bounded synchronous import, no background job/progress service; multipart spool precedes application file quota
Lost response after commit can leave client uncertain; inspect history before retry
Serial reserved-name reference identity; no schema reference flag or cross-owner/public reference access
No measurement edit/bulk delete or automatic sensor feed
No automatic42features, building-specific forecast, Prediction/recommendation persistence, ML readiness service or admin management panel
Current reference-model validation does not establish applicability to other buildings; existing SQLite/auth deployment limitations remain
phase25_readiness: Raw owned history, exact fields and explicit local timestamps are available for a later authorized continuity/lag feature service; Phase25 not implemented
